    tech.kwik.agent15
    Agent15 is a Java implementation of the handshake protocol of TLS 1.3 (RFC 8446, section 4), running on Java 11.
    tech.kwik.agent15.pqc
    Post-quantum cryptography for Agent15: the PQ/T hybrid key exchange groups of RFC 10024 (X25519MLKEM768, SecP256r1MLKEM768, SecP384r1MLKEM1024), each combining a classical (EC or XDH) key exchange with ML-KEM (FIPS 203); the ML-DSA (FIPS 204) signature schemes (mldsa44, mldsa65, mldsa87).
